name: curatormd
description: CuratorMD: local-only project intelligence, reviewable persistence, and safe evidence-based curation for Codex projects.

interface.longDescription: CuratorMD captures bounded redacted project-scoped observations, generates human-reviewable proposals, records separate local learning and QA outcomes, and promotes only explicitly approved decisions into the four persistence documents. Learning state is isolated by profile and repository root; automation stays disabled until explicitly authorized evidence gates pass.
defaultPrompt: Recall the relevant CuratorMD project knowledge before coding.
Record this reviewed decision as durable project knowledge.
Capture the verified lesson from this failure without storing secrets.
